description: Build color harmonies from base colors. Pass `colors` (one to six colors as hex, rgb(), hsl() or CSS names, comma or newline separated, or an array) and optionally `harmony` (complementary, analogous, triadic, split-complementary or tetradic) to return one scheme. Hue is rotated in OKLCH with lightness and chroma held, so the set is evenly weighted; colors that cannot hold the chroma inside sRGB are reduced and marked. Returns hex and oklch() for each color, a note on which harmony suits which job, and a list of near-duplicates (OKLab distance under 3, a working convention). Near-gray bases have no hue and are flagged. OKLCH opposites differ from the red-yellow-blue paint wheel. Pure maths, nothing stored.

colors.description: One to six base colors: a string such as "#1b3a5c, #e4572e" or an array of strings.

harmony.description: Return only this harmony. Omit for all five.
